name: facebookresearch_sam2/sav_dataset/utils/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_sam2/sav_dataset/utils/.run_benchmark_evaluation: run the benchmark function to evaluate video object segmentation predictions against ground truth masks across datasets
facebookresearch_sam2/sav_dataset/utils/.create_video_evaluator: create a VideoEvaluator instance to evaluate a single video's predicted masks against ground truth masks
facebookresearch_sam2/sav_dataset/utils/.run_evaluator_feed_frame: run the Evaluator class to feed frame-by-frame mask and ground truth pairs for IoU and boundary F-score computation
facebookresearch_sam2/sav_dataset/utils/.convert_segmentation_to_boundary_map: convert a segmentation mask to a binary boundary map using the _seg2bmap function for boundary analysis
facebookresearch_sam2/sav_dataset/utils/.compute_iou_score: compute the Intersection over Union score between two masks using the get_iou function with intersection and pixel sum

facebookresearch_sam2/sav_dataset/utils/.decode_video_frames: decode a video file and return RGB frames as a list of numpy arrays
facebookresearch_sam2/sav_dataset/utils/.show_annotation_masks: show segmentation annotation masks with colored overlays and optional borders on the current matplotlib axis
facebookresearch_sam2/sav_dataset/utils/.create_SAVDataset: create a SAVDataset instance to load and visualize the SAV dataset annotations with configurable sample rate
facebookresearch_sam2/sav_dataset/utils/.read_video_frames: read video frames from an MP4 file and downsample them to align with annotations
facebookresearch_sam2/sav_dataset/utils/.visualize_video_annotations: visualize manual and auto annotations on a specific frame of a video using the SAVDataset class
